status: BUILT: mechanism compiled + 9 ACTI records authored + BOS ini emitted; runtime smoke pending
intent: Make the man_DaedricShrines decorative statues clickable: a once/day prayer that grants a flat +2 piety to that Prince. Requested 2026-06-15.

mechanism.award: path.AdjustStoredPiety(2.0, source) on the Prince at pathIndex in PDV_FLST_DaedricPaths_All. Flat +2, NO commitment/tier/active-pact side-effects (unlike HandleDaedricPrinceSignal which is +10 + pact logic).
mechanism.onceADay: Enforced by the activator's built-in OncePerDayKey property (StorageUtil game-time, (now-last) < 1.0 day).
mechanism.note: These .psc live in the Anvil Devotion mod (not repo-tracked); recompiled .pex deployed there. The repo records the change via this manifest.

activatorPropertyForms.note: PlayerREF + PDV_GLO_OriginRace + PDV_GLO_DebugLevel can be left unassigned: PlayerREF falls back to Game.GetPlayer(); origin global is unused when RequiredOriginRace=-1; debug global only gates tracing. So the ONLY required property is PDV_EventBusService.

bosSwap.file: PDV_AuthoriaARR_ShrinePrayer_SWAP.ini (ship in the ARR compat mod)
bosSwap.form: For each perShrine entry: Form = <swapFromStat>|<created ACTI FormID> (BOS swaps the statue STAT base -> the PDV prayer ACTI, which carries the same .nif model so it looks identical but is now clickable). Fill the ACTI FormIDs after the records are created.
bosSwap.note: BOS is active in ARR (po3_BaseObjectSwapper.dll). Base-swap hits all refs of the statue base; man_ statues are placed only at the curated shrine locations, so this is surgical.
